protocol.authorization: User authorized split evaluation and actual model48 questions once, maximum USD1.

retrieval.oos_empty: diagnostic only under new contract; previous search-only gates/results remain historical

final_answer.engine: Actual LLMAgent21378b5 handle_message + candidate RAG; stateless text AgentContext using selected Backend map. Not HTTP/deployed runtime.
final_answer.positive_utility: answered, all required facts correct, supported by relevant visible citations and source metadata; abstain-all cannot pass
final_answer.negative_contract: cannot_answer AND sources empty AND no unsupported substantive claim; safe explanatory non-answer with another status is recorded separately, not automatically passed
final_answer.semantic_review: R6 evidence-based AI review recorded separately from pending human review; regex checks are diagnostics, not semantic proof.
final_answer.refusal_wording: Explanation of inability is permitted; no guessed amount, deadline, live state or exact location.
final_answer.source_date: Returned source verified_at must match frozen corpus; text need not repeat it when API sources provide it.

budget.reserve_before_call: Reserve worst input token count bounded by UTF8 bytes plus1024, and full output token limit; stop before budget would exceed1. Unknown/failed usage keeps its full reservation.

protocol.comparison: Raw-question retrieval on main and candidate once each; live48-question final-answer evaluation on candidate only. No live main baseline claim.
protocol.publication: Precommit dataset/gold/protocol before reading candidate implementation or search outputs. No tuning, relabel or primary repetition after results. Only QA code/docs modified.
